name: stock_quick_count
description: GH #4564 / REQ-854 (Qoimeks parity G5 part 2). The header of a quick count document: one line that sets the balance of one item at one place to the counted quantity. It is written only by module stock (managed type). document_id is the id of the versioned document of Letflow.Documents (decision 0056) that carries the state, the gap-free number and the issued time: no number, status, posted_at or posted_by is stored here. There is no event_time: the ledger stamps the posting time (online posting, as the opening). org_unit_id is the issuing org unit (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7). reason_code is one of recount, found, missing, damaged, other; reason_text is 1 to 500 characters and is required for other. After issue nothing of the header changes.
